title.rendered: Labour Colony in Noida — Prefab Worker Housing

content.rendered:
Looking for a labour colony in Noida that can be supplied, delivered, and installed without slowing your construction schedule? SAMAN Portable manufactures prefabricated labour colonies and worker housing built on an IS 2062 MS frame with insulated PUF panels. As construction continues across Sector 62, Sector 137, and Noida Extension, site teams need worker accommodation that is compliant, durable, and quick to set up. We supply that directly from our own factory, so you deal with the manufacturer, not a reseller.

SAMAN manufactures and dispatches labour colony units directly from our Greater Noida facility (Jalpura, PIN 201308) — factory-to-site delivery across Delhi NCR without middlemen. For a Noida site this is the closest SAMAN factory of all — a short, same-region dispatch from Greater Noida 201308, with no inbound transport markup and no reseller in the chain.

As a direct manufacturer — serving India since 2009, incorporated as SAMAN POS India Private Limited in 2019 (POS = Portable Office Solutions) — we build to IS 2062 structural steel under ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 45001 systems, with 500+ projects delivered across India and NSIC and DPIIT recognition. Our portable labour hutments carry a warranty of 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. Large sites are expected to provide suitable worker accommodation under the Building and Other Construction Workers (BOCW) Act and related state welfare rules, which cover sanitation, minimum space per worker, ventilation and fire safety — a planned colony supports these requirements.

Noida's ongoing construction creates steady demand for prefab worker housing

Why Worker Housing in Noida Matters

Noida's construction sector keeps expanding across Sector 62, Sector 137, and Noida Extension. Traditional masonry housing is slow to build and hard to relocate, which does not fit fast-moving construction timelines. Prefabricated labour colonies solve this by arriving as factory-built panel units that assemble on site in days, not months.

Construction companies also have to maintain proper living conditions for workers — adequate sanitation, ventilation, safe electricals, and fire exits. A well-built prefab labour colony gives you a clean, organised worker camp that supports site discipline and keeps accommodation off the critical path of your project.

A managed labour colony keeps the workforce housed close to the site

SAMAN POS India Private Limited has been serving India since 2009 (incorporated in 2019) with 500+ projects delivered across the country. For Noida and the wider NCR, our worker housing is dispatched from our own North-India factory, so lead times and logistics stay under our control.

Talk to the manufacturer directly. We can supply and install prefab worker housing across Noida's construction corridors.

Factory-Direct Dispatch to Noida from Greater Noida

This is where SAMAN Portable stands apart from directory listings and middlemen. We do not source labour colony units from a third party — we manufacture them. Our North-India plant is at Jalpura, Greater Noida 201308, which sits in the same district belt as Noida. That same-region location means your prefab labour accommodation ships a short distance to most Noida construction sites, keeping transport simple and installation scheduling tight.

Because the units are made in-house to IS 2062 steel standards, we control quality, customisation, and dispatch end to end. You get manufacturer pricing, manufacturer specifications, and a single point of accountability from quote to handover — backed by our ISO 9001:2015 quality system.

SAMAN Portable's Labour Colony Design

From layout to finished unit: SAMAN's modular labour colony approach

Our prefabricated labour colonies are engineered to provide safe, comfortable accommodation while keeping installation fast. Each layout is planned around your worker count, site footprint, and the amenities you need.

Core Design Features

  • Modular worker rooms with flexible configurations
  • RCC base for stability and durability
  • G+1 structures with MS staircases to save ground footprint
  • Drainage planning to prevent waterlogging
  • Dedicated toilet blocks with proper sewage management
  • Fire safety equipment and clear emergency exits

Interior of a standard labour colony worker room

G+1 structures with MS staircases maximise accommodation per plot

Each unit is planned for worker wellbeing — proper ventilation, electrical outlets, and personal storage. Common areas can include washing facilities and designated cooking zones, so you get a complete living environment, not just rooms.

Durable Structure: IS 2062 MS Frame and PUF Panels

Technical detail of the MS frame and insulated PUF panel build

SAMAN Portable's labour colonies are built to withstand Noida's hot summers and monsoon conditions while staying comfortable inside. The structural system balances durability, insulation, and fast on-site assembly.

Structural Components

  • IS 2062 MS structural frame for strength and load capacity
  • Insulated PUF panels (around 50–60mm) for thermal comfort
  • RCC foundation base for stability and longevity
  • MS staircases and railings for safe vertical access
  • Profiled sheet roofing with proper waterproofing
  • Anti-skid flooring for safety in all weather

Weather-resistant materials used across our labour colony units

The insulated PUF panels reduce heat transfer, keeping interiors cooler in summer and warmer in winter, which improves worker comfort and lowers running costs. The structure carries a warranty of 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life, so you know exactly what is covered and for how long.

Built to Last Through Noida's Seasons

IS 2062 MS frame and insulated panels for long-life worker housing.

Labour Colony Configurations for Different Noida Projects

Different project types need different worker accommodation layouts. The table below shows typical configurations we plan for real estate, road, metro, commercial, and IT-park sites across Noida. Capacities and setup windows are indicative and confirmed against your actual site at quote stage.

Project Type Colony Configuration Key Features Indicative Capacity
Real Estate Development G+1 Cluster Enhanced living spaces, supervisor quarters 100–500 workers
Road Construction Linear Arrangement Easily relocatable, phased setup 50–200 workers
Metro Construction High-Density Blocks Enhanced security, multi-shift accommodation 200–800 workers
Commercial Buildings Compact Vertical Small footprint, noise-reducing layout 80–300 workers
IT Park Development Premium Modules Better facilities and finishes 100–400 workers

Because the units are modular, a labour colony can be disassembled and relocated to your next site, which spreads the cost across multiple projects in the Noida region.

Layouts for High and Low-Density Noida Sites

Noida sites vary from space-tight urban plots to larger peripheral areas in Noida Extension. We plan the labour accommodation layout to fit the footprint you have.

High-Density Urban Sites

  • Vertical G+1 and G+2 configurations
  • Space-optimised common facilities
  • Compact toilet and washing blocks
  • Maximised accommodation per square metre

Medium-Density Mixed Sites

  • Cluster arrangements with central facilities
  • Balanced indoor-outdoor spaces
  • Modular expansion capability
  • Optimised walkways and access points

Low-Density Peripheral Sites

  • Spread layouts with dedicated zones
  • Enhanced common and recreational areas
  • Separate cooking and dining facilities
  • Improved natural ventilation and spacing

Modular design lets the colony grow as your workforce grows

Our design team plans each layout around minimum space and essential-facility requirements, so the colony works for both your workers and your site managers. You can explore the full prefabricated labour colony range to see standard module options.

Ready-to-Occupy Setup with Full Amenities

Turnkey labour colony installation with complete amenities

SAMAN Portable delivers ready-to-occupy labour colonies. The setup covers the essential amenities, so your workforce can move in once installation is signed off.

Standard Amenities

  • Sleeping quarters with bunk-bed layouts
  • Electrical wiring with lighting and power outlets
  • Toilet blocks with proper plumbing and septic systems
  • Washing areas with adequate drainage
  • Designated cooking zones with safety features
  • Potable water storage and distribution
  • Fire safety equipment and emergency exits
  • Ventilation throughout the units

Hygienic toilet and washing facilities

Our installation team handles site preparation, foundation work, structure assembly, and amenity fit-out. This turnkey approach keeps worker accommodation off your project's critical path. We also offer a return window within 7 days of delivery or installation, in line with our standard policy.

FAQs: Labour Colony in Noida


How fast can a labour colony be installed in Noida?

Because the units are factory-built and dispatched from our Greater Noida plant, on-site assembly is far quicker than masonry construction. The exact timeline depends on colony size and site conditions, which we confirm at the quote stage after assessing your location and worker capacity.


What does a labour colony in Noida cost?

Pricing is quote-based because it depends on worker capacity, number of floors (G+1 or higher), amenities, and site layout. Share your requirement and we will give you a manufacturer-direct quote. Call +91 62009 09435 or use the enquiry form above.


Is delivery faster because your factory is near Noida?

Yes. Our North-India factory is at Jalpura, Greater Noida 201308, in the same district belt as Noida. Manufacturing and dispatching from there keeps the route to your Noida site short and the logistics under our own control as the manufacturer.


What warranty comes with the labour colony?

Our worker housing carries 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. The 20–25 years is the engineered service life of the structure, not a warranty period.


Can the colony be relocated after the project ends?

Yes. The modular panel-and-frame design allows the colony to be disassembled and moved to your next site. This is useful for companies running phased or sequential projects across the Noida and NCR region.


What is the structure made of?

The units use an IS 2062 MS structural frame with insulated PUF panels (around 50–60mm), an RCC foundation base, MS staircases and railings, profiled-sheet roofing, and anti-skid flooring. All manufacturing is backed by our ISO 9001:2015 quality system.

Certifications and Manufacturer Credentials

SAMAN POS India Private Limited (POS = Portable Office Solutions) has manufactured steel labour colony units since 2009 (incorporated 2019), with 500+ projects across India from our plants at Gopasandra, Bengaluru 560099 and Greater Noida (Vill Jalpura, Tehsil Dadri, Greater Noida, Gautambudha Nagar, Uttar Pradesh 201308). Certifications and registrations: ISO 9001:2015 (Cert No. E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (Cert No. E20250218646), ISO 45001:2018 (Cert No. E20250218647), NSIC enlisted (Ref. NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207), DPIIT-recognised startup (Ref. DIPP56005), Udyam registered (UDYAM-KR-03-0172770), GST 29ABBCS7101B1ZR (Bangalore) and 09ABBCS7101B1ZT (Noida). IS 2062 MS frame with insulated PUF panels. See our portable labour hutments or the full labour colony range.
